title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-005
doc_notes: This is a collection of FAA investigative reports regarding a pilot sighting of unidentified aerial phenomena; encounter content is present.

encounters.summary: The crew of JAL Flight 1628 reported observing unidentified lights and radar targets while flying over Alaska, which paced their aircraft for approximately 45 minutes.
encounters.quote: The three crewmen stated that just after passing POTAT intersection... they observed strange lights ahead of their B-747.
